description: bertholomus's DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TensorFold TP4 recipe v0.3.6 (deepseek-v4.1-tensorfold-tp4-4xgb10 16f65a98, Apache-2.0), with three lane values from tonyd2wild's four-Spark fleet (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-TP2-and-TP4-DGX-Sparks 74ac0136, runs/2026-10-26-1017-tensorfold-v035-4bpw). Engine: bertholomus/TensorFold deepseek-v41-zig-tp4 at the kit's ENGINE_COMMIT 953bd6fd, which carries tonyd2wild's TF_RDMA_GID and TF_SEED_RANDOM/TF_TOP_K_MAX changes upstream. It is built here as RUNNING.md section 1 builds it (Zig 0.17.0, the CUDA toolchain of nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.07-py3, aarch64 + sm_121; the creator publishes no image), with a build-time sm_121 kernel scan. Weights: bertholomus/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-EXL3-4.0bpw at f3657818, readied by the recipe's tools/serving_1017.py (serving-1017.safetensors, checked once against the creator's recorded digest). The Engram tables are the original checkpoint's shards 47 and 48. The kit's image bias is the kit file RUNNING.md names, because the 4.0 bpw quant carries only 40 of its 43 tensors. Kit, chat template, run-time inputs and every served setting are bertholomus's (config.env.example, scripts/serve.sh): 1,048,576-token context, 16 streams, 2D parity split, waves, draft-cost table C, TF_DS_IDX_SPLIT=8192, chunked prompt fill, structured output and forced tool calls through libtfgrammar, and a 2 GiB kept-prompt cache on rank 0. Thinking is on by default with temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95 and top_k 20; requests can override all of these. The rank caches, token map and kit are derived into /outputs/cache and reused on restart. Deviations from bertholomus, from tonyd2wild's lane: the shared position pool is 29,360,128 positions instead of 20,971,520, because a recipe that uses all four Sparks owns them; the Controller's RoCE rails are used, both halves when both are authorized; and the RDMA rings' GID index is the Controller's (TF_RDMA_GID), where the engine defaults to 5. Memory: the pool costs about 0.87 GiB per 1M positions on every node. The declared peaks are tonyd2wild's measurement at this pool, made on v0.3.5 (engine 0a0b69a5), so the hardware try re-measures them on v0.3.6. In his run (results/memmin_under_load.txt), the lowest MemAvailable under a 600,000-token needle plus 16 streams x 3 replies and the C1-C16 bench was 7.08 GiB on rank 0 and 8.43-8.56 GiB on ranks 1-3. Each peak is 130,663,231,488 bytes minus that free memory minus the 4,063,231,488-byte idle host use admission charges: 119.0 GB on the entrypoint and 117.55 GB on the workers. Upstream figures are claims until measured here. The recipe needs four Sparks; Vonk physical acceptance is pending. Licences are information only: the recipe is Apache-2.0, and TensorFold and the DeepSeek weights are MIT.
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 EXL3 4.0bpw TensorFold TP4 (bertholomus)
